I am a computer scientist working at the intersection of machine learning, scientific computing and ecological modelling.
I completed my PhD in Computer Science at Université de La Réunion, in collaboration with CIRAD.
I will join the LBBE at Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1 as a postdoctoral researcher.
My research focuses on the development of machine learning and scientific machine learning methods for environmental and ecological applications.

title: Frédérick Fabre Ferber
text:
I am Frédérick Fabre Ferber, i completed my PhD in Computer Science at Université de La Réunion, in December 2025 in collaboration with CIRAD.
My research focuses on machine learning methods for small, noisy and spatially structured datasets, with applications to agronomy and ecology.
I will join the LBBE at Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1 as a postdoctoral researcher, working on hybrid modelling of multi-species forest dynamics using PINNs (Physics Informed Neural Networks).
